evidence.dominant_driver: Euro-area flash consumer confidence fell 1.0 point to -16.5, below the -16 consensus and reversing part of four months of recovery.

absorption.reason: European equities had already rallied on lower oil/AI optimism; the confidence miss is small relative to those drivers.

evidence.decision_notes: Small data miss; empty learning profile, no confidence adjustment.

XAUUSD.regime: earlier around $4360; no sufficiently fresh exact print

regimes.risk: US equities near records; Nasdaq firm, Dow weaker
regimes.energy: oil below $100 and declining on diplomacy/supply relief
regimes.rates: US yields easing with oil, but Fed path remains hawkish
regimes.geopolitics: Iran diplomacy headlines mixed: mediation efforts coexist with Trump pressure/escalation rhetoric

immediate.rationale: Small miss is unlikely to overpower the existing oil/AI risk-on tape.

15m.rationale: Small miss is unlikely to overpower the existing oil/AI risk-on tape.

1h.rationale: Consumer softness conflicts with lower-energy relief.

4h.rationale: No strong residual catalyst after the initial release window.

predictions.mechanism: Weaker consumer sentiment is growth-negative, while cheaper energy is growth-positive.
predictions.invalidation: A broad European selloff with weaker EUR and higher spreads would make the signal bearish.
predictions.counter_case: Cheaper oil raises real household income and can quickly reverse confidence damage.
